backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a construction project tracking system with role-based access control (Admin, Foreman, Buyer, Finance), managing materials, jobs, vendors, RAP templates, material requests with multi-stage approval workflow, progress tracking, and realization reports.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features including authentication with Internet Identity, master data management (materials/jobs/vendors), RAP/RAB creation with nested jobs, template system, material request workflow, approval processes, and reporting capabilities.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains summaries of two frontend files: App.tsx (main router setup with authentication flow) and JobList.tsx (hierarchical job display with CRUD operations), noting fixes for React hooks and TypeScript errors.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI components including sidebar, charts, and semantic tokens (primary, secondary, destructive, etc.).
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Construction Project Tracking System React application with viewport meta tag and root div mounting point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component with TanStack Router configuration, Internet Identity authentication flow, profile setup modal for new users, and route definitions for all application pages (dashboard, master data, RAP builder, requests, approvals, reports).
frontend/src/components/dashboards/Admin: Admin dashboard displaying statistics for materials, jobs, and vendors with quick action buttons to navigate to master data management, RAP builder, and template pages.
frontend/src/components/dashboards/Buyer: Buyer dashboard showing pending approval count, realization reports total, and material tracking status with quick links to review requests, add reports, and view material usage.
frontend/src/components/dashboards/Dashb: Reusable card component that displays a title, value, icon, and description in a structured layout using shadcn/ui Card components.
frontend/src/components/dashboards/Finan: Finance role dashboard showing pending approvals, total expenditure, and approved requests with quick action links to finance review and accounting reports.
frontend/src/components/dashboards/Forem: Foreman role dashboard displaying material request statistics (total, pending, in-progress, approved) with quick action buttons for creating requests and tracking progress.
frontend/src/components/jobs/JobForm.tsx: Dialog form for creating or editing jobs with fields for name, volume, unit, cost, and optional parent job selection to support hierarchical job structures.
frontend/src/components/jobs/JobList.tsx: Table component that displays jobs in a hierarchical tree structure with indentation, supporting add, edit, and delete operations.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main layout wrapper component that combines Header, Sidebar, Footer, and main content area in a flex-based layout structure.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Footer component displaying copyright information and a branded link to caffeine.ai with UTM tracking parameters.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Application header showing the Construction Tracker branding, user profile information (name and role), and login button.
frontend/src/components/layout/Sidebar.t: Role-based navigation sidebar that filters and displays menu items with icons based on the current user's AppRole, highlighting the active route.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Login/logout button component using Internet Identity hook with loading states, error handling for duplicate authentication, and query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/materials/Materi: Dialog form for creating or editing materials with fields for name, unit, and price, using mutations to persist changes.
Displays a table of materials with add, edit, and delete actions. Uses custom hooks to fetch and mutate material data, and renders MaterialForm in a dialog for create/update operations.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Modal dialog component for first-time user profile setup, collecting name and role (Foreman, Buyer, Finance) with form validation and non-dismissible dialog behavior.
frontend/src/components/vendors/VendorFo: Dialog form component for creating or editing vendors with name, address, and phone fields. Submits data via useAddVendor or useUpdateVendor mutations and closes on success.
frontend/src/components/vendors/VendorLi: Displays a table of vendors with add, edit, and delete actions. Uses custom hooks to fetch and mutate vendor data, and renders VendorForm in a dialog for create/update operations.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state. Creates authenticated or anonymous actors and invalidates dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context with login, logout, and identity state management. Creates and manages AuthClient with configurable options and handles identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including user profiles, materials, jobs, vendors, RAP templates, material requests, progress records, and realization reports. Each entity has CRUD operations with toast notifications.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom earth-tone color palette using CSS variables for light and dark modes. Includes primary terracotta, secondary sand, accent green, and chart colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the App component into the root DOM element.
frontend/src/pages/AccountingDashboardPa: Displays financial overview with total budget, actual spending, and variance calculated from approved material requests and realization reports. Includes tabs for budget analysis, cash flow, and financial reports (placeholder content).
frontend/src/pages/BuyerReviewPage.tsx: Allows buyers to review pending material requests and approve them by setting price and quantity. Displays requests in a table with job and material names, and opens a dialog for approval.
frontend/src/pages/CreateRequestPage.tsx: Form page for creating new material requests by selecting a job, material, and entering quantity. Submits request via mutation and resets form on success.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Routes users to role-specific dashboard components (Admin, Foreman, Buyer, or Finance) based on their user profile's appRole.
frontend/src/pages/FinanceReviewPage.tsx: Enables finance users to perform final approval on material requests by reviewing and setting final price. Displays pending requests with buyer price and opens approval dialog.
frontend/src/pages/MasterDataPage.tsx: Tabbed interface for managing master data with three tabs: Materials, Jobs, and Vendors, each rendering its respective list component.
frontend/src/pages/MaterialUsagePage.tsx: Displays material usage summary for a selected material, showing total requested and approved quantities in card format with material details.
frontend/src/pages/MyRequestsPage.tsx: Displays a table of the current user's material requests with job name, material name, quantity, approval status badges, and buyer/finance prices. Fetches data using custom hooks and maps IDs to names for display.
Provides a form to record progress percentages for main jobs and displays a history table of all progress records. Includes summary statistics cards showing total main jobs, progress records count, and average progress.
frontend/src/pages/RAPBuilderPage.tsx: Placeholder page for the RAP Builder feature with a coming soon message directing users to RAP Templates.
frontend/src/pages/RAPTemplatesPage.tsx: Displays a grid of RAP template cards showing template names and job counts, with an empty state when no templates exist.
frontend/src/pages/RealizationReportPage: Allows users to add realization reports by entering actual prices from vendor invoices for materials, and displays a table of all existing realization reports with material names, actual prices, and vendor names.
frontend/src/pages/SCurvePage.tsx: Visualizes project progress using a line chart comparing actual vs planned progress over time, with summary cards showing total main jobs, progress records, and average progress percentage.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support and functions to store, retrieve, and clear parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom color scheme using OKLCH color space with CSS variables, extended theme for borders/shadows/animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing a construction project tracking application with RAP/RAB management, unlimited nested sub-jobs, multi-stage approval workflow, accounting system, progress tracking with S-Curve, and role-based access control using React/TypeScript frontend and Motoko backend on Internet Computer.
